titles.native: ジュヴナイルポルノグラフィ THE ANIMATION

description:
A mysterious girl was reading a book, seated in the same position every day. Until one day, when a boy who parted with his friend after playing tried to greet the girl. Curious of what the girl was reading, the boy asked "what are you reading about?" With a sweet smile from the girl, she replied "come sit next to me, let me tell you what I'm reading." The girl told a sex story from a book she read. After reading it, the girl said "my house is nearby, do you want to come to my house?"

(Source: Nekopoi)
